mechanics.title: Cape sources
mechanics.description: Config screen lets you pick the cape type, toggle cape texture on elytra, use a cape selector, and open the OptiFine cape editor.

getting_started: Works automatically after install; configure via Mod Menu.
name: Capes
summary: Displays capes from OptiFine, LabyMod, Cosmetica, Wynntils, Capes++ and MinecraftCapes on your own character and on others. Has a config screen to choose cape source and toggle.
